subject: CanvasBridge SDK interoperability & pilot ops
messages:
From: Priya Shen <priya@canvasbridge.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Quick sync: CanvasBridge + Redwood SDK compatibility

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks again for the intro at the LA partner meetup — CanvasBridge enjoyed the conversation. We built a lightweight SDK that extends LangChain / LlamaIndex connectors with tracing hooks and configurable prompt transforms. A few ISVs in our ecosystem have reported good results on Redwood Dedicated and we wanted to explore a co-owned pilot to validate interoperability and performance claims.

High level ask: would Redwood be open to a 6-week pilot (sandbox + small prod path) to:
- validate our runtime bindings with Redwood's token-level tracing and KV cache behavior
- test a small set of LangChain agents that call into Redwood-hosted models with prefix caching enabled
- jointly collect perf telemetry and a short quality eval on representative prompts

If this sounds interesting, can we schedule a 30–45m technical + commercial sync this week? I’ve looped in our infra lead Arjun (cc).

Cheers,
Priya Shen
Head of Partnerships, CanvasBridge

Priya — great to hear from you and glad you enjoyed the meetup. We’re definitely interested in a pilot to validate integration with LangChain/LlamaIndex SDK flows and to compare telemetry surface area.

Quick notes / next steps:
- Can your team share a short pilot scope (3–5 integration tests + 2 eval prompt sets) and a draft SOW?
- I’m looping Kimberly (partner eng) and Mateo (solutions) to handle the tech checklist and runbook.
- We have capacity for a kickoff this Thursday or Friday afternoon (PST) for a 45m technical alignment.

For commercial packaging, we typically run a small reserved sandbox for pilots (no charge) and then an optional short-term dedicated burst for performance validation. We can surface a proposal after the first sync.

Thanks — V.
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference
From: kimberly_park <kimberly@redwood.inference>
To: Priya Shen <priya@canvasbridge.com>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.inference>
Cc: mateo_alvarez <mateo@redwood.inference>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 08:21:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick sync: CanvasBridge + Redwood SDK compatibility

Hi Priya — looking forward to the sync. A few technical questions to help scope the runbook:

1) Which LangChain / LlamaIndex versions are you targeting? We’ve seen compatibility differences across 0.0x/0.1x releases.
2) Do your tracing hooks rely on token-level timestamps or just event-level markers? Token-level traces will require a small instrumentation change on the SDK side to correlate Redwood token ids.
3) For prefix/KV caching tests: do you have sample inputs where caching is expected to reduce token count?

If you can drop the pilot scope and a draft SOW (PDF/Docx) before the call, I’ll prepare an internal test plan and identify the infra contacts for sandbox provisioning. I’ve attached our partner runbook template and a short checklist I use for SDK pilots.

—Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Principal Partner Engineer, Redwood Inference
attachments: partner-runbook-template.md (referenced)
From: Priya Shen <priya@canvasbridge.com>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly@redwood.inference>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.inference>
Cc: Arjun Rao <arjun@canvasbridge.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 11:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick sync: CanvasBridge + Redwood SDK compatibility

Thanks Kimberly — answers inline and attaching a short SOW + security questionnaire:

1) LangChain: 0.1.7 and 0.1.9; LlamaIndex: 0.6.x. We can spin minimal containers pinned to each version.
2) Our tracing sends event-level markers by default; we can enable token-level timestamps behind a feature flag (we’ll need the Redwood token id mapping).
3) Yes — we’ll include two sample prompt families where caching reduces repeated context across multi-step agents.

Attached: canvasbridge-sow-draft-v1.pdf, canvasbridge-security-questionnaire.xlsx, pilot-runbook-outline.md

For the kickoff: Thursday 11/12 at 1:30pm PST works for our team. I’ll send a calendar invite.

Best,
Priya

Great kickoff today — appreciate the clear scope. Capturing immediate action items and owners: 

- CanvasBridge: finalize SOW (v1 -> v1.1) with explicit success metrics for caching hit-rate and end-to-end tail latency (owner: Priya) — due EOD Mon 11/15.
- CanvasBridge: enable token-level tracing flag and provide mapping doc for Redwood token ids (owner: Arjun) — due 11/16.
- Redwood (Kimberly): provision sandbox project with reserved nodes and enable prefix cache for the two sample prompt families; share telemetry dashboard link (owner: Kimberly) — ETA 11/17.
- Redwood (Mateo): produce evaluation harness for the two prompt sets and publish an initial quality report (owner: Mateo) — ETA 11/20.
- Legal / Procurement (Vanessa): route SOW to procurement and request a standard partner MPA with the CanvasBridge commercial rep (owner: Vanessa) — target 11/18.
